result.target_topic: Supplier engagement for Scope 3 emissions reduction
result.target_summary: By fiscal year 2026, NVIDIA aims to engage manufacturing suppliers comprising at least 67% of its Scope 3 category 1 GHG emissions to adopt science-based targets.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: No counterpart found in 2023. The 2024 disclosure specifies a new policy to engage 67% of Scope 3 Category 1 manufacturing suppliers in adopting science-based targets by FY2026. 2023 records (e.g., D046, D063) discuss general fabless strategy and renewable energy goals but do not contain this specific supplier engagement metric or target.

current_disclosures.summary: By fiscal year 2026, NVIDIA aims to engage manufacturing suppliers comprising at least 67% of its Scope 3 category 1 GHG emissions to adopt science-based targets.

materiality_analysis.reason: The 2024 filing introduces a specific, quantified new initiative: engaging 67% of Scope 3 Category 1 manufacturing suppliers to adopt science-based targets by FY2026. The 2023 filing contained no such specific supplier engagement metric or target. This represents a new strategic priority and operational dependency metric in the company's supply chain management.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company outsources the manufacturing of board-level graphics products to third-party manufacturers.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose their reliance on third-party manufacturers for hardware production. While NVIDIA specifically highlights a sustainability initiative aiming to engage suppliers for Scope 3 emissions reduction targets, AMD discloses the operational fact of outsourcing board-level graphics manufacturing. This indicates that both companies share the business model characteristic of outsourcing manufacturing to third parties, which serves as the context for NVIDIA's supplier engagement goals.

sentences.text: By fiscal year 2026, we aim to engage manufacturing suppliers comprising at least 67% of NVIDIA's scope 3 category 1 GHG emissions with goal of effecting supplier adoption of science-based targets.
We outsource board-level graphics product manufacturing to third-party manufacturers.
